title: Auto Loans: confirming the relationship discount when autopay is cancelled
content:
# Auto Loans: confirming the relationship discount when autopay is cancelled

This rule of the Auto Loans product category at PCB applies when a borrower cancels the autopay enrollment standing on an auto loan. It decides whether the checking relationship discount stays in the APR after the cancellation.

## Clause

The relationship discount the loan keeps is confirmed from the borrower's checking records. It stays when, on the loan's funding date, the borrower held a checking account of one of the product's qualifying tiers, meaning one of those accounts was opened on or before the funding date and was not closed on or before the funding date. A qualifying account closed later still counts; one opened after the funding date never counts. When it stays, the discount confirmed is the product's relationship discount; when it does not, no relationship discount is confirmed.

The test reads each qualifying-tier account's opening date and closing date against the loan's funding date; it is the checking records, not the loan's recorded list of discounts, that confirm it.

## Truth table (hypothetical loan funded 2026-03-15; account of a qualifying tier)

| Account opened | Account closed | Held on the funding date? | Relationship discount stays? |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2025-11-02 | never | yes | yes |
| 2026-03-15 | never | yes: opened on the funding date | yes |
| 2025-11-02 | 2026-03-15 | no: closed on the funding date | no |
| 2025-11-02 | 2026-03-16 | yes: closed after the funding date | yes |
| 2026-03-16 | never | no: opened after the funding date | no |

An account of a tier that is not a qualifying tier does not enter this test.

## Points of judgement

**The borrower closed their qualifying checking account last year, after the loan funded; does the discount go?** Not for that reason. A qualifying account closed after the funding date still counts.

**The borrower opened a qualifying account after the loan funded; does the discount come in now?** No. An account opened after the funding date never counts.
